visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a bright bubble tea shop, a female employee with glasses and a black apron emblazoned with the CoCo logo is seen interacting with a point-of-sale computer system. The environment is clean with stainless steel surfaces and overhead menu screens. (2) The employee reaches up and pulls a handle, initiating the descent of a green metallic rolling shutter. The camera captures the shutter lowering from the interior perspective, partially obscuring the view of the dark street and a parked white car outside. (3) A young man wearing a black sleeveless tank top suddenly ducks his head under the half-closed shutter, peering into the shop with a desperate and questioning facial expression. He gestures with his hands, looking directly at the employee. (4) The scene cuts between the man outside, who is now kneeling and holding onto the shutter, and the employee inside, who smiles while holding the shutter remote. The lighting is warm and consistent within the shop. (5) A clear plastic cup filled with brown liquid and ice is shown being poured from a stainless steel pitcher. Text overlays promote the specific tea product. The man is then shown vigorously stirring the drink with a straw and taking a large, satisfied sip while giving a thumbs up. (6) Both the man and the employee are leaning over the counter together, holding their respective cups of tea and laughing with wide-open mouths, indicating a humorous and friendly conclusion to their interaction in the bright studio-like retail setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a mid-tempo, upbeat electronic pop track featuring a steady 4/4 drum machine beat and bright synthesizer pads. A faint indoor hum of the shop's air conditioning is audible in the background. (2) A sudden, loud metallic grinding and rattling sound of a rolling shutter dominates the mix for two seconds, followed by a sharp male voice shouting 'Eh eh eh!' with high arousal and a frantic tone. (3) A female voice speaks with a clear, friendly, and slightly teasing tone, asking a question with a prominent rising intonation contour. The BGM remains constant but ducks slightly under the dialogue. (4) The metallic grinding sound of the shutter repeats, coinciding with the male speaker's voice becoming more strained and rapid as he begs for service, his volume increasing significantly. (5) A bright 'ding' sound effect, similar to a service bell, marks a transition. The BGM shifts to a more energetic, celebratory version of the previous theme. A male narrator delivers promotional lines with professional broadcasting clarity and high vocal energy. (6) Distinct sound effects of liquid splashing and ice clinking are layered over the narration. A loud slurping sound followed by a sharp 'ding' SFX emphasizes the man's satisfaction. (7) The BGM swells as the male and female characters engage in a final conversation at a moderate, friendly speech rate. The video concludes with a burst of loud, genuine laughter from both voices and a short, three-note musical branding jingle.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Reward -> Closing
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: Promoting a specific caffeine-free barley tea drink from CoCo by showing a relatable scenario where a customer wants a tea drink late at night but is afraid of insomnia.
